▎ Auto mode is now Claude Code's default
▎ permission mode.
▎ Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts
▎ automatically. Claude checks each tool call for
▎ risky actions and prompt injection before
▎ executing, runs the ones it assesses as
▎ lower-risk, and blocks the rest.
▎ https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes
